groups.why_chosen: In current serverless platforms, how functions are invoked (coarse, workflow-driven) and how their data actually flows (fine-grained, all-to-all, or time-batched) are treated as one thing but are not.
groups.what_to_learn: a single invocation arrow paired with a dense mesh of dashed data-flow arrows to show that control and data flow diverge; an explicit two-line legend distinguishing solid invocation arrows from dashed data arrows
